title: Green Account (checking) specifications and requirements
summary: This document outlines Green Account (checking) ongoing requirements and fees: $22.50 monthly maintenance unless you keep a $1,350 daily balance, plus $2.50/month for paper statements. It also lists 0.11% APY, $3.00 non-network ATM fees, 3-business-day external transfers, $15 domestic wire receiving fees, $17.50 returned check deposit fees, and $4,000/day debit purchase caps.
